related.title: ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管
related.titleEn: ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid
related.transfer: 可遷移「為什麼要分兩級溫度」與「一萬噸冷質量的降溫」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Why two temperature levels are used" and "Cooling down ten thousand tonnes of cold mass" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦世界最大的集中式氦冷凍廠：兩級溫度、氦存量、壓縮功、降溫能量與缺氧防護；ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管則以史上最大的超導磁體系統：環向場線圈匝數、鈮三錫線材、中央螺管伏秒與現場繞製的極向場線圈為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the world's largest centralised helium refrigeration plant: two temperature levels, helium inventory, compression work, cool-down energy and protection against oxygen deficiency; ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid centres on the largest superconducting magnet system ever built: toroidal field turns, niobium-tin strand, central solenoid volt-seconds and poloidal field coils wound on site, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「低溫冷凍的電力代價」與「磁壓與比壓」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「氦壓縮機的壓縮功」的模型移到ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「高溫超導電流引線」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "The electrical cost of cryogenic cooling" and "Magnetic pressure and beta".
Move the model of "Compression work of the helium compressors" to ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "High-temperature superconducting current leads", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「為什麼要分兩級溫度」與「一萬噸冷質量的降溫」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 超導磁體與中央螺管的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Why two temperature levels are used" and "Cooling down ten thousand tonnes of cold mass" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER Superconducting Magnets and Central Solenoid must be respecified.

related.title: ITER 真空室與低溫恆溫器
related.transfer: 可遷移「為什麼要分兩級溫度」與「一萬噸冷質量的降溫」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 真空室與低溫恆溫器的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Why two temperature levels are used" and "Cooling down ten thousand tonnes of cold mass" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER Vacuum Vessel and Cryostat must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦世界最大的集中式氦冷凍廠：兩級溫度、氦存量、壓縮功、降溫能量與缺氧防護；ITER 真空室與低溫恆溫器則以兩層真空邊界：雙層壁真空室、世界最大的不鏽鋼真空容器、熱屏蔽與烘烤為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the world's largest centralised helium refrigeration plant: two temperature levels, helium inventory, compression work, cool-down energy and protection against oxygen deficiency; ITER Vacuum Vessel and Cryostat centres on two vacuum boundaries: the double-walled vacuum vessel, the world's largest stainless vacuum chamber, thermal shields and baking, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「低溫冷凍的電力代價」與「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「氦壓縮機的壓縮功」的模型移到ITER 真空室與低溫恆溫器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「真空抽氣與壁處理」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "The electrical cost of cryogenic cooling" and "Device size and plasma volume".
Move the model of "Compression work of the helium compressors" to ITER Vacuum Vessel and Cryostat, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Vacuum pumping and wall conditioning", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「為什麼要分兩級溫度」與「一萬噸冷質量的降溫」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 真空室與低溫恆溫器的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Why two temperature levels are used" and "Cooling down ten thousand tonnes of cold mass" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER Vacuum Vessel and Cryostat must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: ITER 低溫廠與氦冷凍系統
history.text: 2012 年氦冷凍機合約簽訂；2016 年冷箱運抵工地；2021 年低溫廠主要設備安裝完成；2024 年氦冷凍機進行調試。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2012: The helium refrigerator contract was signed. 2016: Cold boxes arrived on site. 2021: Main cryoplant equipment was installed. 2024: Helium refrigerators were under commissioning. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
